name: Saint Dominic
history: A Castilian canon who, travelling through southern France, saw how the Cathar heresy had won people from the Church, and how little the faith was being preached. He answered with poverty, study and preaching, and founded the Order of Preachers, approved in 1216. His friars spread quickly to the universities and cities of Europe.
life: Dominic de Guzmán was born at Caleruega in Castile and studied at Palencia, where in a time of famine he sold his precious books to feed the hungry. As a canon of Osma he travelled with his bishop, Diego, through Languedoc, where the Cathars taught that the material world was evil. Dominic saw that the people respected their preachers’ austere lives, and resolved to preach the Gospel in the same poverty, on foot and begging his bread. In 1206 he gathered converted women into a community at Prouille, the first of his nuns. In 1216 Pope Honorius III approved his order, and Dominic soon sent his small band of friars to Paris, Bologna and beyond, to study and to preach. Those who knew him said he spoke only with God or about God, and that he was cheerful by day and wept in prayer by night. He died at Bologna in 1221 and was canonised in 1234.
prayerTo: Saint Dominic, you gave your life to preach the truth with charity and joy. Pray that I may love the truth enough to study it and live it, and speak of God with gentleness to those who do not know Him. Win for the Church preachers who are poor, learned and holy. Amen.
penance: Spend twenty minutes today reading Scripture or a good book of the faith, and pray one decade of the Rosary, which tradition links with Dominic.
meditation: Dominic’s friars were to contemplate and to hand on to others the fruits of contemplation. What have you received from God lately that you could share with someone else?
